ModMetaData.name: 鼠异诅咒独立模组 Ratkin Curse Standalone
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
鼠异（Ratkin Anomaly）的诅咒机制非常有趣，但是需要各种前置并且不能只对殖民者生效，本模组将其从原模组抽出并独立实现，无需鼠异本体。
特性： - 五种诅咒（无桌吃饭、研究、杀戮动物、受伤、伐木）各自拆分为独立事件，外加一个随机诅咒事件，可同时存在多种诅咒； - 所有事件默认不会被叙事者触发，只能由玩家主动触发； - 模组选项：可设置诅咒只对殖民者生效；可开启永久诅咒模式，永久模式下的诅咒同时也可作为剧本的永久游戏状态添加，效果相同。
The curse system from Ratkin Anomaly is really interesting, but it requires the Ratkin mod as a dependency and cannot be configured to affect only colonists. This standalone mod extracts and reimplements that curse system without requiring the original mod.
Features: - Each of the five curses (eating without table, research, killing animals, getting wounded, cutting trees) is its own separate incident, plus a random-curse incident; multiple curses can be active at the same time; - None of the incidents are fired by storytellers by default; they can only be triggered manually by the player; - Mod options: curses can be limited to colonists only; a permanent curse mode is available, and permanent curses can also be added as scenario permanent game conditions with identical effects.
